plugins.description: Gives Claude source-level knowledge of its own architecture. 113 lessons covering every internal subsystem — hooks (all 30 event types, PreToolUse-bypasses-canUseTool, hook input contract), permissions (7-phase pipeline, 23 validators), boot sequence, agents, compaction, MCP, memory, sessions, plugins, AskUserQuestion, and binary-verified Claude Cowork internals through v2.1.159 + Claude Desktop app.asar 1.17377.2 + in-VM agent 2.1.197 (Cowork Spaces, Scheduled Tasks, Tasks tool, SDK file-checkpointing, host-loop shared-scratch/path-namespace model, control-protocol contract, production GrowthBook gates). Searchable via RRF (keyword + TF-IDF fusion).
